rule: COORDINATOR STANDARD 1 (owner 10-16 ~19:45, safe margins): measured reach per die = planning constant (relay tile launch + capture + neighbour skew, TT); every die net longer than 0.9 x reach is a registered relay chain from the plan; die generators set repair_design -max_wire_length = reach (never above) so a long unrelayed wire is a hard error, never buffered.
consumer: tools/die_reach.py (reach_um / add_args / from_args / repair_tcl); a design missing here fails closed
formula: reach = (T 833.333 - U 60 - SKEW 90 - o_launch - s_capture) / 0.76 ps/um TT buffered die wire, o = O - R_tt, s = S + R_tt from the real relay view ETMs + insertion.json (tools/hier_contract/pair_check.py TREE model)

hbm.method: H-DIE 10-16 14:50: formula on the real hbfd_rly views: rly_624 456-488, rly_48 413-421, rly_136/304/1136 385-470 um; coordinator-declared planning reach 450 um (station plan d4b_relay_stations_450, relay contract '<=450 um' check)

s81.method: formula, self pair (relay -> same relay master) over the 26 S81 dsfd_rly_* relay masters with real ETMs in view_timing.json; minimum = dsfd_rly_266_SN 455.0 um (rly_283 461.8-470.7, rly_63/66/68/54 474-485, rly_15 500-502, rly_2 535-541). stn* stations reach 693-704 (not the limit).
s81.note: tools/dsrom_s81_fulldie.py / tools/s81/die_sta.py run no die-level repair_design (relay-only die top); the value is the planning constant for any future die repair step
